mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% consistently predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to compressed discount rates for equity valuations during monetary easing cycles, with the signal active whenever the rate is in this range.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as earnings expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 0.5% each month indicate broad demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days through multiplicative wealth effect and sectoral spillovers.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) during manufacturing contraction regimes signals reduced corporate output capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO declines > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Annualized CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days as central bank tightening expectations compress equity valuations and reduce risk appetite.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL is above 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in unemployment (UNRATE) and declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) exceeding 0.3pp and 0.5% respectively indicate labor market stress, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days through interaction effects.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp and PAYEMS growth declines > 0.5%
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp and PAYEMS growth declines > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1000 thousand units consistently predict positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days due to positive wealth effects and construction sector momentum, with the signal active whenever HOUST exceeds this threshold.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1000 thousand units.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 95 (index) signals manufacturing weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days as supply chain disruptions and earnings revisions accelerate.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO is below 95.
